result.title: When Does Looking Closer Pay Off? Simple Foveated ViTs for Fine-Grained Recognition
result.summary: Fine-grained recognition benefits from high resolution, but not every image region needs it. We study a foveated Vision Transformer (FoVT) that uses last-block class attention from a 224-pixel glance to select regions for refinement. Fine patches from the 448-pixel image replace the selected coarse cells, and the same backbone classifies the mixed-resolution input. We evaluate FoVT on five benchmarks with two seeds and 26 configurations per dataset. Attention beats random selection on all five benchmarks, by up to 2.45 percentage points overall and 4.18 points on the smallest objects. At equal transformer cost, Holm-corrected tests detect no FoVT deficit relative to a port of the official CF-ViT, but no dataset shows a corrected FoVT advantage in both seeds. FoVT requires no feature reuse, distillation loss, or selection schedule. Reusing coarse features shows no significant benefit and costs 1 to 3 points when the reuse module is trained at the head learning rate. Skipping refinement for the most confident 19 to 24 percent of images leaves accuracy unchanged to two decimal places. At the transformer cost of uniform 336-pixel inference, gated FoVT improves accuracy on four benchmarks, with the largest gains on NABirds and FGVC-Aircraft and no significant gain on Stanford Dogs. Foveation primarily saves computation: relative to a uniform 448-pixel model trained with the same auxiliary glance loss, ungated FoVT uses 44 percent fewer transformer operations, with no significant accuracy difference on four benchmarks and a 0.53-point deficit on FGVC-Aircraft. Wall-clock savings are smaller than the reduction in transformer operations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FoVT：用 224 像素整图 glance 的末层 class attention 选取区域，以 448 像素 patch 替换后由同一 ViT 分类，并在五个细粒度基准上系统比较注意力/随机选区、特征复用、置信样本跳过细化与计算成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本：注意力选区优于随机、跳过最自信样本几乎不掉点、墙钟节省小于算子节省，可供核查视觉证据筛选与动态计算预算；但属纯视觉细粒度分类，未涉及 latent 推理状态。
